It is often given to boys and is associated with the idea of a fresh start or new beginning. In many Muslim cultures, the early morning Fajr prayer is considered to be particularly powerful, and the name Fazar serves as a reminder of this important practice and the importance of starting the day with God in mind.

The name connects us to the idea of the dawn, a time of renewal and restoration, and encourages us to approach each day with a sense of hope, intention, and determination to do good and serve God in all that we do. It is a beautiful reminder that every day is a new opportunity to seek God's guidance and mercy, and to strive to live a better, more productive and meaningful life.
